director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch jaise rakhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Pitch ko 0 se 1 tak ek seedhi line socho.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
samajh nahi aaya

0 se 1 ki line ko 2 barabar gaps mein baanto. Beech wala mark 1/2 hai, aur woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Zaroor. Riya, pehle dekho: bhinn poore 1 ko barabar hisson mein baantti hai. Neeche ka ank batata hai ki kul kitne barabar hisse hain. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

near 3 sahi nahi hai. Screen par ghar se chai ki dukaan tak 0 se 1 km ki sadak hai, aur khilona beech wale mark par ruka hai. Woh ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka number 1/2 km hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech. Yahan tak theek hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Screen par upar wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, par ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Neeche ek doosri line hai, jis par beech mein 7 marks hain. Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Dekho, yahi 1/4 ab patti par. Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. Screen par 0 se 1 metre tak ka ribbon hai, beech mein 3 chalk ke nishaan hain, aur ribbon 4 barabar hisson mein bata hai. Bhinn hisse ka naam hai, nishaan ka nahi, isliye pehla nishaan 1/4 metre par hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi, aap batao
Nishaan nahi, unke beech ke gaps gino. 7 nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada bante hain. 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?
director.card: 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?

director.text: ruko, main khud karti hoon
Theek hai, Riya. Tum khud karke batao.
one eighth of a metre

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 7 nishaan ribbon ko 8 barabar hisson mein baantte hain, aur pehla nishaan pehle hisse ke end par hai. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab 8 tha, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain, 7 + 1 = 8. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

cricket yaad hai, yeh hissa khatam karke uspar aate hain. Is baat par hum is sawaal ke turant baad wapas aayenge. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/5 sahi nahi hai. Aur cricket ki baat: Cricket mein ek over mein chhe ball hoti hain, aur ek team mein gyarah khiladi. Screen par 0 se 1 ki ek hi line par teen mark hain: 1/2, 1/4 aur 1/8, aur 1/8 bilkul 0 ke paas hai. Neeche ka number jitna bada, hissa utna chhota, aur woh 0 ke utna paas rukta hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Ab bhinn ko sankhya rekha par rakhne ka ek naya tareeka dekhenge. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line par 1/3 ka mark hai. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/3 ke beech, ya 1/3 ke baad?
director.card: Screen par 0 se 1 ki line par 1/3 ka mark hai. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/3 ke beech, ya 1/3 ke baad?

director.text: samajh nahi aaya
Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
theek hai

Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab 1/10 tha, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Pehla kadam dekho. Ghar ko 0 par aur school ko 1 par rakho. Ghar se school tak ka poora raasta ek poora hai. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
achha
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
haan
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

director.text: 1/4 km hai na

Bilkul, Riya, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Tumne marks se ek zyada gaps ginke 1/4 km nikala. Ab batao, tumne kaise jaana ki pehla khamba 1/4 km par hai?
maine pehle chhota wala socha, phir bada

Pichhle sawaal ka jawab 1/4 km tha, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 km door hai, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?
director.card: Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai, kyunki beech ke 2 marks line ko 3 barabar gaps mein baantte hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai. Ab agla card dekho. Ek baar 0 se 1 ko 3 barabar gaps mein baanto, ek baar 10 barabar gaps mein. 0 ke zyada paas kaun hai: 1/3 ya 1/10?

Theek hai Riya, tum rukna chahti ho—ab chun sakti ho: padhai jaari rakhen, chhota break lein, ya aaj ke liye rok dein?
